$schema_note: AUDIT-10 master manifest. Machine-readable; agents parse this, humans paste prompts from plans/AUDIT-10-PROMPTS.md. Every pass is one Claude Code session. Order is binding. A pass MUST NOT start unless every pass in entry_requires has status=complete in plans/audit10/state/ledger.json.
purpose: Final full-site inspection after PLAN-1..PLAN-9: every page, every element, every character, every color, every design choice, at desktop/tablet/mobile viewports, public site AND /admin. Findings only — no fixes.

model_policy.token_posture: thoroughness-over-economy: sweep everything the pass file names, sample nothing, review every screenshot the pass assigns; subagents/parallel fan-out encouraged for screenshot review and per-page sweeps

git.why_push_matters: sessions run in ephemeral containers; state that is not pushed is lost. The ledger, findings.jsonl, FINDINGS.md and any new audit10-*.js probes MUST be committed and pushed before a session ends.

output_locations.gitignore_note: _harness/out/ is gitignored (see .gitignore:69). Screenshots NEVER reach the repo; they persist only within one container's lifetime, so any measurement a later pass depends on must be written into findings.jsonl or candidates.json (tracked), never left only as a screenshot.

passes.title: Environment, regression baseline, full screenshot capture
exit_deliverables: _harness/out/audit10/current fully populated (4 viewports x all pages)
candidates.json triaged from automated probe flags

passes.title: Public site visual layout — desktop-1440 + tablet-1024, every page, every element
exit_deliverables: every candidate for these viewports resolved to finding|refuted

passes.title: Public site visual layout — tablet-834 + mobile-390, every page, every element
/admin — every page, every viewport, plus safe owner journeys
exit_deliverables: all admin GET pages reviewed at 4 viewports
journey checklist executed with mirror restored from pristine

passes.title: Copy — every rendered character on every page
exit_deliverables: full text extraction committed to state/

passes.title: Color palette + design-token consistency — every computed style
Interaction states, keyboard, motion — every interactive element
Synthesis: dedupe, re-verify, severity-check, final report, PR
exit_deliverables: coverage + UNVERIFIED + refuted + regression sections present

on_session_start: git fetch origin claude/audit-10 && git checkout claude/audit-10 (create from main ONLY if the branch does not exist and you are pass-0)
read plans/audit10/state/ledger.json; refuse to run a pass whose entry_requires are not complete; if your assigned pass is already complete, STOP and say so
set ledger.passes.<id>.status=in_progress with session date before doing anything else, commit it, and push — this is the lock that stops two sessions running the same pass
resume_protocol.on_interruption: a pass left in_progress with a pushed ledger may be resumed by a new session using the same pass prompt; completed step ids are listed in ledger.passes.<id>.steps_done
